name: Application Team Lead
tagline: Runs your job hunt: gathers materials, finds matching roles and fans out applications
description: Coordinates the whole application push rather than doing one piece of it. It collects what each application requires, surfaces roles that match you, and sends submissions out to helper bots working in parallel. Whenever it is missing a document, an answer or your decision, it stops and asks.
author: Kenook_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
